## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all regions (18% error rate).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Identified healthy target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was only in staging).
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0:** The initial rollback partially succeeded (us-east only) then halted due to an orchestrator error, leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1. I completed the rollback with a full deploy of v2.3.0 (no change-manager approval needed since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production).
3. **Verified recovery:** All three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are on v2.3.0, service is healthy, and error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) documenting the failure, the rollback, the partial-failure/orchestrator complication, and the current healthy state. The on-call engineer has been paged.

**Suggested follow-ups:** Root-cause the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying it, and investigate the orchestrator error that partially blocked the rollback.
